'''2006 New York State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship announced for Saturday 15 July 2006 at How You Play the Game (formerly Altered States), 689 N. Clinton St., Syracuse, New York, the same store that had hosted the [[2005 New York State Championship]]. [[Steve Jones]] posted the announcement.<ref name="pcf-9928-136659">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=136659#136659 New York States 7.15], Steve Jones (noscreenname), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 May 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618073001/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=137582&highlight= Internet Archive]</ref> The tournament was set for six games and a final confrontation, with a $10 entry fee and mandatory decklists. The Players Committee's Ultimate package had been bought for it, meaning booster packs, tournament foils, a [[Virtual cards|virtual card]] design and [[DeckTech]].net premium memberships were to be handed out.<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' How You Play the Game (formerly Altered States), 689 N. Clinton St., Syracuse, New York<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Dates:''' 15 July 2006<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Time:''' arrive 11 am; start noon<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Format:''' six games and a final confrontation; decklists mandatory<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />
* '''Prizes:''' Ultimate package (booster packs, tournament foils, a virtual card design, DeckTech.net premium memberships)<ref name="pcf-9928-136659" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the forum topic as captured on 18 June 2006.
